def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # divider value = most frequent single value forming full lines
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find divider color: color with a full row or full column
    div=None
    for c in cnt:
        if any(all(x==c for x in r) for r in g) or any(all(g[i][j]==c for i in range(h)) for j in range(w)):
            div=c; break
    rows=[i for i in range(h) if all(x==div for x in g[i])]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==div for i in range(h))]
    # source region: first quadrant block
    rs=[0]+[r+1 for r in rows]; cs=[0]+[c+1 for c in cols]
    r0,r1=rs[0],(rows[0] if rows else h)
    c0,c1=cs[0],(cols[0] if cols else w)
    src=[row[c0:c1] for row in g[r0:r1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    import itertools
    rbounds=sorted(set([0]+rows+[h]))
    cbounds=sorted(set([0]+cols+[w]))
    for a,b in zip(rbounds,rbounds[1:]):

            if (a,b)==(r0,r1) and (e,f)==(c0,c1): continue
            for i in range(a,b):

    rows=[i for i in range(h) if all(x==div for x in g[i])]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==div for i in range(h))]
    def mkbounds(idx,n):

        for i in idx: b += [i,i+1]
